remaining_gates: C0-C10 acceptance runner execution owned by root after concurrent changes settle

Release image rebuild is not exact scanned-byte promotion
Example reference-agent lock metadata stale; no dependency graph refresh performed
Semgrep --error now makes findings fail CI; remote workflow/scanner must run against final source
